links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT outputs across repeated identical simulation runs
links.effect: ChatGPT's outputs varied despite consistent input across 20 repeated runs; same actions persistently missed.
links.quote: We found that ChatGPT's outputs varied despite consistent input, the same actions were persistently missed, repetitive overemphasis hindered guidance, and erroneous medication information was presented.

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT adherence to 2020 AHA ACLS guidelines steps
links.effect: Median step accuracy 85% (IQR 40%-100%) cardiac arrest, 30% (IQR 13%-81%) bradycardia; per-attempt median 69% and 42%.
links.quote: ChatGPT's median accuracy over 20 simulation attempts for cardiac arrest was 69% (IQR 67%-74%) and for bradycardia was 42% (IQR 33%-50%).

links.outcome: Erroneous medication information in ChatGPT ACLS outputs
links.effect: Erroneous medication information was presented in ChatGPT's responses during simulations.
links.quote: We found that ChatGPT's outputs varied despite consistent input, the same actions were persistently missed, repetitive overemphasis hindered guidance, and erroneous medication information was presented.

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT's raw accuracy across simulated ACLS clinical scenarios (cardiac arrest and bradycardia) without testing any organizational guardrail, intervention, or deployment practice.
